$comment: Shared definitions for ifc7 plugin input/output contracts (v0).
title: Plugin contract shared definitions
description: Reusable building blocks for lint and compare plugin schemas.

InterfaceType.description: Interface type identifier (for example OPENAPI or JSON_SCHEMA). Expand this enum when new types are added.

FileFormat.description: Serialization format of the specification document bytes after base64 decoding.

PluginOptions.description: Optional plugin-specific settings. Unknown keys may be ignored. v0 imposes no required option keys.

SemanticExtra.description: Optional extensions beyond the required semantic fields. Must not duplicate required semantic fields (score, breaking).

RawOutput.description: Textual detail for this run. Empty string is allowed when there is nothing to report.
